analysis: Gram-Schmidt is the largest training ratio. 317 of349 canonical execution samples (90.83%) are self time in its generated numeric function. Prior rejected bounds/copy candidates remain preserved; an identical source candidate must not be retried.

Correlation is the second-largest training ratio. Its sampled execution includes repeated collection helpers, numeric-map entry, inner transpose and row-block publication. The emitted current Object contains only the scalar deviation map and inner correlation map plus transpose; no rectangular map is selected.

The rectangular-map compiler currently accepts only literal inner range bounds. Correlation uses the same original U64 inclusive range factory with literal lower bound and a current input upper bound. This prevents fusion despite the inner source being immutable across the enclosing rectangular nest.

Fill this general compiler gap by admitting current immutable inner U64 range bounds, with the original selected-factory cardinality, full finite source/replay envelopes and current-owner validation. Do not alter source ports or specialize on benchmark names.
